notes: Sermon extract. Bible Characters (1902) is a multi-author compilation; the Moody section is headed 'Bible Characters described in his soul-winning sermons', and the editor's introduction says he 'culled from their utterances choice selections'. Several pieces are only a page long. No text is stated. Opening words: “Naaman was a successful, valiant and noble man. But he was a leper—and that spoiled him. What a blight that must have cast on his path! It must have haunted …”
